subject: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karolina Nowak <karolina.nowak@linguacorp.pl>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes

Hi Karolina / LinguaCorp team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good conversation and helpful context on the two feature flows you mentioned (live chat summarization + post-purchase FAQ). Two quick recaps and proposed next steps so we can get a lightweight bakeoff running next week: 

Recap / model-fit hypotheses
- Primary concern: high precision on short, instruction-like queries in Polish and Romanian (EU), plus conversational fluency in Indonesian and Thai (APAC).
- Candidate families we recommend for first pass: Redwood-mix-medium-quant and Redwood-llama3-13b-slim. For strict latency SLOs, we can test a 4-bit quantized variant.
- Risk areas: tokenization mismatch for Polish compound words and Thai segmentation; hallucination risk on localized product terminology.

Attachments and artifacts (linked below)
- Prompt pack v1: curated prompt templates (prompt-sets/linguacorp_prompt_pack_v1.jsonl) — includes positive/negative examples and few-shot seeds.
- Benchmark IDs: small suite of focused tests for EU/APAC (benchmarks/linguacorp-eu-apac-bench-ids.txt).
- Proposed bakeoff schedule (attached spreadsheet) with per-locale test windows.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) You confirm target locales for Phase 1 (suggested: pl, ro, id, th).
2) LinguaCorp provides a short sample set (200 anonymized queries per locale) by Wednesday so we can seed tokenization checks.
3) Redwood runs a 72-hour bakeoff across the two candidate families + a quantized variant and shares per-locale tokenization error rates, latency/throughput numbers, and qualitative failure examples.
4) Quick sync to review results and agree on pilot scope.

I copied Rafael (engineering lead) and Markus (head of solutions) for scope/ops alignment, and Neha from GTM for pricing/discovery notes.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cL10nBakeoff
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/LC-2028-042

Thanks — let me know if you'd like the bakeoff window shifted earlier.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes

Thanks Monica — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications before we send sample sets: 

- For Polish and Romanian, can you confirm whether the tokenization checks will also flag compound-splitting errors versus simple OOV counts? We care a lot about preserved meaning in product names.
- For Thai/Indonesian, we have a dataset of user chats that must remain within our VPC for privacy — can Redwood run the bakeoff in Dedicated or Private for those files?
- Timeline: We can deliver the samples by Wednesday EOD (CEST).

I'll loop in our L10n ops contact if we need to set up a secure transfer.

—Karolina
Karolina Nowak
Head of Localization Engineering | LinguaCorp
karolina.nowak@linguacorp.pl
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karolina Nowak <karolina.nowak@linguacorp.pl>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes

Karolina — great q's, short answers below and next actions: 

- Tokenization checks: yes — Rafael's team will produce both OOV/token split diagnostics and a compound-word semantic-check that labels samples where the tokenization likely changes meaning (we'll surface examples).
- Private/Dedicated run: we can run the bakeoff in a customer-managed Private deployment or on Redwood Dedicated pools depending on your security policy. I'll flag this in HubSpot and Rafael will reach out to ops for a brief checklist.
- Sample delivery: Wednesday EOD works. We'll start the bakeoff as soon as we receive samples; target report within 72 hours of ingestion.

Rafael — can you confirm capacity for a dedicated bakeoff run next week and list the minimal onboarding steps for LinguaCorp's L10n ops?

Thanks,
Monica
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes

On Mon, Jun 30, 2028 at 14:03 Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rafael — can you confirm capacity for a dedicated bakeoff run next week and list the minimal onboarding steps for LinguaCorp's L10n ops?

Hi all, quick note from infra — we have capacity to run a 72-hour bakeoff in Dedicated next week. Minimal onboarding checklist for Private/Dedicated:

1) Access: LinguaCorp provides a user account (SAML) or a short-lived upload token for dataset ingestion.
2) Dataset packaging: CSV/JSONL with locale tag, input, expected output (if available); as a minimum we require input + locale.
3) NDA/transfer: if the data is sensitive and you need Private, we'll sign the transfer addendum; otherwise, we can run in Dedicated under the existing contract.
4) KV/cache policy: let us know whether you want prefix caching enabled for the chat flow — caching improves latency but can affect freshness.

I'll follow up with a one-page ops checklist and an S3 upload guide.

-Rafael
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karolina Nowak <karolina.nowak@linguacorp.pl>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Localization fit: bakeoff plan, prompt sanity checks, and EU/APAC regression notes

Perfect — Karolina, thanks for confirming sample delivery for Wednesday. I've attached an updated bakeoff schedule with explicit locale windows and included a pricing note for Dedicated runs in the sheet. Also attached the first prompt pack (v1) and the bench IDs; Rafael's ops checklist will be in Drive by tomorrow morning.

Next immediate asks for LinguaCorp:
- Upload 200 anonymized samples per locale to the secured folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cL10nBakeoff (we will provide S3 upload instructions if you prefer).
- Confirm whether you want prefix caching enabled for the chat flow (yes/no).

If we get samples Wednesday morning UTC, Redwood will start ingestion same day and share an interim tokenization/latency snapshot within 24 hours. Final bakeoff report expected 72 hours post-ingestion.

I'll schedule a 30-minute review once results are in — provisional time suggested in the attachment.

Thanks all — looping Neha to track pricing and next steps for procurement.

Best,
Monica
